summary: Tested the bookmarks bar, copy from the live page, the saved-password vault (save, fill, agent sign_in) and the unusual-traffic fix on the cloud target. All requested features work. Backend: test_iter11_vault_bookmarks.py passed 8/8 and the test_iter9_stream.py regression passed 7/7. (1) Unusual traffic: on httpbin /headers the User-Agent is 'Chrome/156.0.0.0' with no 'HeadlessChrome', and Sec-Ch-Ua includes 'Google Chrome'. navigator.webdriver is undefined, plugins=5 and languages are en-US,en, checked in a new workspace. An omnibox search for 'best grant programs 2026' in a new workspace ended on bing.com/search?q=... (Google returned /sorry/ and the Bing fallback worked), so it never stayed on the sorry page. (2) Bookmarks API: create, duplicate (same id returned), list, delete then 404, javascript:/ftp: rejected with 400, user B cannot see or delete A's bookmarks, and requests without auth get 401/403. (3) Bookmarks UI: the star turns blue (fill-[#1A73E8]) and its title becomes 'Remove bookmark'. A chip with favicon and title appears; clicking it navigates the current tab. The same chip shows in a new workspace, the hover X removes it, and the bookmarks-empty hint returns. (4) Copy: dragging over the text highlights it on the page, Ctrl+C shows the 'Copied to your clipboard' toast and the clipboard text matches GET /api/browser/selection. Double-click selects one word ('documentation'). The right-click menu shows copy, paste, select-all and reload; Select all then Copy works, and Copy (menu or Ctrl+C) with nothing selected shows the hint. A click outside closes the menu. (5) Passwords: the key button shows on the login page, lists tomsmith, fills both fields, and Enter reaches /secure. Deleting the login in the Passwords panel (with confirm) shows the empty state. A manual login with a wrong password showed the bubble and Not now hid it. A manual login with the right password showed the bubble with username 'tomsmith'; Save showed the toast, and the login appears in the panel and in GET /api/passwords without any password field. Logging in again did not offer to save again. The key button also shows in a new workspace. (6) API safety: /browser/state never contains pw_sha or the plain password, and saved_logins only has {id, username}. Fill on another site returns 400, user B gets 404, and Mongo password_enc is ciphertext. (7) Agent: the run used navigate -> sign_in(tomsmith) -> click -> finish 'You logged into a secure area!' and ended on /secure. It never asked for the password and the run doc does not contain it. (8) Regression: new and closed tabs, Live indicator, left/right panel toggles and workspace switching all work. Issues found: one medium (input latency, which also makes Ctrl+C copy a partial selection) and three minor.

minor.issue: MEDIUM: every input event (move/down/up/type/key) waits at least 200ms. run_guarded creates the task and then always runs asyncio.sleep(0.2) before checking task.done(), and the WS loop handles inputs one by one. A POST move takes about 0.33s, while a plain GET takes 0.13s. Effects: drag selection trails the mouse, fast typing lags, and Ctrl+C right after a drag copies a partial selection. Reproduced: copied 'needing permission...purposes.' while the selection 2.5s later also included the next paragraph. In the first run, the clipboard got 'This domain ... witho' while the frame showed the full paragraph selected.

The Accept-Language header is sent as 'en-US,en;q=0.9;q=0.9' (q is duplicated), as seen on httpbin /headers. This is an abnormal fingerprint that bot detection can flag. Cause: acceptLanguage 'en-US,en;q=0.9' is passed to the CDP override, and Chrome adds its own q-values on top.

ui_bugs.issue: When the panel is open and the user clicks Save in the save-password bubble, the panel still shows 'No saved passwords yet' until it is closed and opened again. The bubble's onDone only reloads the browser state, not the panel.

The offer appears after a failed login (wrong password, still on /login) because CRED_JS captures on Enter/submit. Chrome waits for a successful navigation before offering. Consider offering only after the URL changes or the password field disappears.

integration_issues.flow: Copy from page right after a drag
integration_issues.issue: copySelection calls GET /browser/selection over HTTP while the drag move/up events are still queued on the WS, which adds at least 200ms per event. The copied text can therefore be shorter than what the user sees highlighted.

action_items: Fix Group.run_guarded latency: check task.done() first, then use `done, _ = await asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=0.2)` in the loop instead of a fixed asyncio.sleep(0.2). Optionally skip the guard for 'move'.

Make Ctrl+C / menu Copy read the selection after pending inputs are processed. For example, ask for the selection over the same WS so it is ordered after the up event, or wait until the input queue is empty.
Pass acceptLanguage 'en-US,en' (no q-values) to Network.setUserAgentOverride, so the header is not 'en-US,en;q=0.9;q=0.9'.
Refresh PasswordsPanel after the bubble saves a password, for example by bumping the SidePanel refresh key.
Optional: only offer to save after the login succeeds (navigation away or the password field is gone).
critical_code_review_comments: shadow_browser.py run_guarded: the fixed 0.2s polling sleep slows down every user input and every agent action.
useBookmarks state is local to each BrowserView. The main window and a solo pop-out do not sync bookmark changes until they remount or reload (there is no polling).

The credential capture also fires on any button click while a password field has a value, so a login the agent fills via sign_in is captured too. already_saved suppresses that offer, which is fine, but a click on a 'Show password' toggle can create an early offer.
shadow_browser.py is over 1100 lines and server.py over 1300 lines; consider splitting them (vault/bookmarks routers, a stealth module).

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all flows pass; latency/copy race and panel refresh are minor)

seed_data_creation: Workspaces TEST_vault, TEST_wd, TEST_lat, TEST_ws_ui and TEST_agent_signin were created and deleted by id; only Main and 'SEARCH FOR EVENTS ONLINE' remain. The TEST_ bookmark and the Example Domain bookmark were removed, so the bookmarks list is empty. The tomsmith saved login was deleted and re-saved through the UI; the new id is e02495b7-3152-40f0-ba2e-50d23e921af2 (the old id f4c9f4ee is gone). Main's active tab was navigated during testing and then restored to the Bing 'best grant programs 2026' search; it may have been logged into the-internet /secure in the meantime.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Clerk tickets are single-use: regenerate with python /app/tests/clerk_token.py shadow.a+clerk_test@example.com ticket > /tmp/tk.txt before each browser session. Main's frame is at x=440,y=176 and 1058x789 at a 1920x1080 viewport. Login fields on the-internet /login are at about (720,525) for the username and (720,588) for the password in page coordinates. PasswordsPanel delete uses window.confirm, so add a dialog handler (import asyncio in scripts). To check Accept-Language and the UA, run the TestStealth tests. Google currently returns /sorry/ from the server IP and the Bing fallback triggers.
rca of the issue: Input latency: Group.run_guarded (shadow_browser.py ~380) does asyncio.ensure_future(coro) and then 'while ...: if task.done(): return; await asyncio.sleep(0.2)'. The first check runs before the task can start, so every call sleeps at least 200ms. Group.input wraps every kind of input in this, and the WS handler in server.py awaits each message in order, so N drag moves add N x 200ms of backlog. BrowserView.copySelection reads the selection over a separate HTTP request before that backlog is processed. To reproduce: drag across example.com text, press Ctrl+C within about 200ms, and the clipboard holds only part of the highlighted text. Fix: replace the sleep with asyncio.wait({task}, timeout=0.2).
